question: What did Shambhu declare in the Prior Scripture about duality and worship?
premises: the former scripture, through Shambhu, says: neither duality nor non-duality
it begins with all liṅga-worship and the rest
the declaration covers the whole rite-complex
inference: The Prior Scripture, in Shambhu's voice, sets aside the duality question and starts from worship itself.
uncertainties: srIpUrva identity (Malini-Vijaya frame) per brief, not decided here
plain_english: And in the former scripture it is said — neither duality nor non-duality — all liṅga-worship and the rest, beginning thus, by Shambhu.
